Great question! Here's what our warranty covers for jackets (and all Trailforge products):

- **Standard Warranty:** All products include a **1-year limited warranty** against defects in materials and workmanship under normal use. (kb/03-warranty.md)
- **Extended Warranty:** An optional **2-year extended warranty** is also available for purchase at checkout on most items. (kb/03-warranty.md)
